subject: Kickoff: Security intake for Carevera — SIG prefill and clarifying Qs
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@carevera.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 14:02:00 -0400
Subject: Follow-up from today's demo — security intake & SOC 2 status

Hi Hannah / Jordan,

Thanks for the demo today — the team at Carevera appreciated the latency/cost breakdown and the routing options you showed. A couple of quick follow-ups from our side so we can move onto procurement: 

- We need to initiate a vendor security questionnaire (SIG preferred). Can you send a prefill or tell us what variant you support (CAIQ/SSAF/Custom)?
- Can you confirm Redwood's SOC 2 status and whether you have a timeline for an SOC 2 Type II report? We have a mandatory gate for SOC 2 for our provider list.
- HIPAA: Carevera handles PHI and requires a signed BAA. Do you have a standard BAA and can you call that out in your security packet?
- Data residency: will data be allowed to stay in us-east-1 only? Any multi-region backups we should know about?

Attaching a redacted architecture diagram so you can see the expected integration surface (attachment: carevera-architecture-redacted.pdf).

Our procurement timeline is tight — ideally we'd like to have the questionnaire started this week and a prefill returned within 5 business days. Let me know the easiest way to get you evidence (shared folder, secure upload, or a direct SFTP).

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Director of Infrastructure
Carevera Health

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@carevera.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@carevera.com>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:10:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's demo — security intake & SOC 2 status

Hi Liam / Priya — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the diagram. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align with your procurement window: 

1) SIG / CAIQ: Redwood can complete a CAIQ v4 prefill (we've standardized on CAIQ v4 for most health customers). If Carevera needs a custom questionnaire instead, we can run that as a follow-up, but CAIQ will get the majority of the evidence covered.

2) SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type II (Security) in Q1 2026. I'll attach the summary and can route the full report under NDA — we also have the SOC 2 bridge letter ready.

3) HIPAA / BAA: We have a standard BAA and a template; happy to start the BAA concurrently with the SIG. A legal contact for signature would speed things up.

4) Data residency: We support pinning to a single region (us-east-1). Backups are replicable to a secondary region for DR, but we can restrict replication for Carevera if required — we'll call that out on the CAIQ.

Proposed immediate actions: 
- I will send a CAIQ v4 prefill template and instructions (attachment: redwood-sig-prefill-instructions.pdf).
- Can you assign a single evidence owner on your side for collection? That will help us keep the 5-business-day target.
- Jordan will scope the HIPAA/BAA specifics and encrypt/KMS questions (cc'd).

If that works, we will start the prefill today and get a first-pass back in 3 business days, with the goal of finalizing evidence in 5 business days. If you instead prefer the custom form, note that adds 2–3 business days to the initial prefill.

Next steps: please confirm the evidence owner and whether CAIQ v4 is acceptable. Also confirm who in procurement/legal should receive the BAA.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-sig-prefill-instructions.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)
From: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 17:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Internal: quick notes on CAIQ prefill for Carevera

Hannah / Karthik — looping in a couple of quick technical notes after reviewing Liam's diagram (quoted below):

- Integration surface: looks like a proxy call pattern from Carevera's API gateway into our hosted API. No direct on-prem model hosting requested in the diagram.
- HIPAA-sensitive pathways: verify logging filters so PHI isn't persisted to general analytics buckets — we'll need to flag the KV cache retention and any debug logging.
- KMS / encryption: Carevera asked about KMS. We should ask whether they require customer-managed keys (CMK) or our managed KMS. If CMK required, that is an enterprise-only config (Dedicated/Private).
- CAIQ items to prefill first: Identity & Access Management, Key Management, Logging & Monitoring, Backup/Restore policy, Data Flow Diagrams, and Evidence mapping (S3 bucket policies, SOC2 controls mapping).

I'll draft answers for the CAIQ sections I know and mark Karthik as owner for encryption/KMS language. Hannah — do you want me to push the prefill draft to the shared Drive folder, or would you rather we send a completed prefill back to Carevera directly?

Hi Liam / Priya — thanks, confirmed — we'll kick off the CAIQ v4 prefill today and target the 3-business-day first-pass. A few clarifications to keep the scope tight: 

- CAIQ variant: CAIQ v4 prefill (accepted) — if you later hand us a custom spreadsheet we'll adapt but start with CAIQ.
- Evidence upload: we can accept a shared Drive folder link (preferred) or a temporary SFTP. I'll create a restricted Drive folder and share edit access to the evidence owner you nominate.
- SOC 2 report: I'll route the SOC 2 Type II summary now; full report available under NDA (I noted your signed NDA attached — thanks).
- BAA: we'll prepare and share a BAA template to your legal contact. If you can share procurement legal@carevera.com as the sig contact, we'll send the DocuSign.

Deliverables & timeline: 
- Today: CAIQ v4 prefill draft pushed to shared Drive and link emailed to your evidence owner.
- Day 3: first-pass prefill returned to you for review.
- Day 5: target to close evidence items for procurement submission.

Please reply with the name and email of the evidence owner and your procurement/legal sig contact. If Carevera has any required evidence formats (e.g., audited penetration test report), call that out now.

Best regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
